imaginations.title: Conditional circle
imaginations.image_or_idea: A circular motif whose pigment shifts blue-to-green with temperature or light, ringed by a thin band that accumulates and displays which state dominated.
imaginations.possible_value: Turns an unresolvable preference dispute into a visible record of conditions, and makes the design's own indecision the point.
imaginations.test_question: Do viewers still report a single preferred colour when the motif never holds one?

revisions.change: When a question supplies symmetric evidence and no criterion, default to 'uncertain' and name the missing criterion rather than selecting a side.
revisions.reason: Selecting under symmetry is unearned confidence; naming the missing criterion is more useful to the asker.
revisions.test: Present a future question with symmetric evidence; if a hidden asymmetry exists that makes one side clearly better, the policy is too blunt and should be revised.
